option.improvedadvancements.old_screen_s: Resize the centered Old window from 60% to 100%, with a minimum size for the controls. 100% is the largest size that fits and the default for new players. Icons, text and terrain keep their size. Reopen the screen to apply.
option.improvedadvancements.old_screen.t: Explore one connected classic map that gradually reveals as you progress. Its prerequisite paths guide discovery; Minecraft awards advancements normally.
option.improvedadvancements.discovery_di: How many locked steps to preview ahead. 0 shows only earned and available goals; 2 reveals the map gradually; 4 uses the original pre-1.12 distance. Earned goals always stay visible. Reopen Old screen to apply.
option.improvedadvancements.scale.tip: Resize the centered tabbed advancements window from 60% to 100%. 100% is the largest size and the default. The Old screen category has its own Screen size setting. Reopen the screen to apply.
option.improvedadvancements.progress.tip: Show the completed count, total and percentage for the selected modern advancement tab in the window title.
option.improvedadvancements.remember.tip: Reopen the modern screen on your last selected tab and at its saved scroll position. This saves your view, not the positions of individual advancements.
option.improvedadvancements.old_remember: Reopen the Old screen at your last map position and mouse-wheel zoom. This setting is independent of the modern screen's saved view.
option.improvedadvancements.stable.tip: Reuse individual advancement positions when the same modern tree appears in another world. This preserves the map layout; Remember tab and position separately preserves where you were looking.
option.improvedadvancements.criteria.tip: Show completed and missing requirements in both screens where Minecraft provides them. Also enables the Old screen's tooltip progress count and bar. Off restores its classic tooltip. Locked and undiscovered goals keep their prerequisite hints.
option.improvedadvancements.shift.tip: Show the requirement checklist only while holding Shift, in both screens. Progress counts and bars remain visible.
option.improvedadvancements.criteria_spe: Seconds to show each page of a long requirement checklist in both screens. Higher values keep each page visible longer.
